title: Senior Platform Engineer (Kubernetes)
description: We run multi-tenant workloads on Kubernetes (EKS). You will own cluster lifecycle, Terraform modules, Helm charts and GitLab CI/CD pipelines. Strong Linux and Bash. Prometheus and Grafana for monitoring, defining SLOs and leading incident response. Python scripting for internal tooling. AWS IAM and ECR.

title: Machine Learning Engineer - LLM Systems
description: Build retrieval augmented generation pipelines. Embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering with OpenAI and Anthropic models. Python, FastAPI. Model serving, evaluation and MLOps practices. Docker and AWS Bedrock experience valued.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description: SRE role owning availability for a payments platform. SLOs, error budgets, incident command. Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, AWS. Observability with Prometheus, Grafana and Datadog. Python or Go for automation. PostgreSQL and Redis.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python / React)
description: Django and FastAPI services with a React and TypeScript frontend. PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, CI/CD on GitHub Actions. REST API design, unit testing with pytest and Jest. Agile team, code review culture.

title: DevOps Engineer (AWS)
description: Own AWS infrastructure as code with Terraform. Kubernetes on EKS, Helm, Docker. Build CI/CD pipelines with GitLab CI. Linux administration, Bash, Python. Security focus on IAM and OAuth. Monitoring and alerting.

title: Frontend Developer (React / Next.js)
description: Build marketing and product surfaces in React and Next.js with TypeScript and Tailwind. Responsive design, accessibility, Jest testing. Figma to code workflow. GraphQL data layer.

title: Data Engineer
description: Build ETL and data pipelines with Airflow and Spark. Python, pandas, SQL and PostgreSQL. Kafka event streaming. Docker and AWS. Data quality and testing practices.

title: Backend Engineer (Ruby on Rails)
description: Ruby on Rails monolith moving toward microservices. PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq. REST API design, RSpec testing. Docker, CI/CD, AWS deployment. Agile delivery.

title: MLOps Engineer
description: Own model serving and deployment infrastructure. Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform on AWS. Python, model monitoring and drift detection, CI/CD for ML. Experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch model packaging.

title: Salesforce Administrator
description: Administer Salesforce org, build reports and dashboards, manage users and permissions. Apex triggers and Lightning Web Components a plus. Stakeholder training and documentation.

title: Cloud Security Engineer
description: Harden AWS environments. IAM policy design, OIDC federation, least privilege. Kubernetes security, container scanning, penetration testing. Terraform, Python automation. Incident response.

title: Technical Writer (Developer Docs)
description: Write and maintain API reference and tutorials for a developer platform. Comfortable reading code in Python and JavaScript. Git based docs workflow. Working with engineers to clarify behaviour.
